page_intro: Run Lightning Address discovery one step at a time and inspect every intermediate value.
page_meta_description: Inspect Lightning Address discovery for NIP-57 zaps
address_split_outro: without normalizing or silently correcting the input.
endpoint_resolved: Endpoint resolved without an HTTP request
endpoint_prerequisite: Complete Step 1 and explicitly resolve the endpoint.
fetch_response_prerequisite: Review the resolved URL in Step 2, then explicitly run the GET request.
recipient_notice_intro: Recipient pubkey identifies the person receiving the zap. It is separate from the LNURL provider
parameters_prerequisite: Step 4 requires a valid LUD-06 response, supported NIP-57 advertisement, callback, amount range, and LNURL-pay URL.
build_request_prerequisite: Validate Step 4, then explicitly build the Zap Request.
signing_error_notice: {error}. The unsigned event is preserved; you can retry.
sign_request_prerequisite: Build and validate an unsigned event in Step 5 first.
callback_prerequisite: Sign the Zap Request in Step 6 first. The callback is only requested when you explicitly continue.
invoice_amount_mismatch: Invoice amount does not match requested amount
inspect_amount_prerequisite: Get a Lightning invoice from the callback in Step 7 first.
sent_zap_request_json: Zap Request JSON actually sent in Step 7
direct_description_warning: This invoice contains a direct description (d) instead of a description hash (h). It is not a NIP-57 Zap invoice, so a Zap Receipt is not expected.
field_calculated_description_hash: SHA-256 of the sent Zap Request JSON
description_hash_match: Invoice description hash matches Zap Request
description_hash_mismatch: Invoice description hash does not match Zap Request
verify_hash_prerequisite: Decode the Lightning invoice in Step 8 first.
regular_invoice_payment_warning: This is a regular Lightning invoice, not a NIP-57 Zap invoice. Payment may succeed, but a Zap Receipt is not expected.
regular_invoice_payment_instruction: Pay this invoice with your Lightning wallet.
zap_invoice_payment_instruction: Pay this invoice with your Lightning wallet, then continue to the next step.
after_zap_payment: After paying the invoice, continue by waiting for the Zap Receipt.
payment_prerequisite: Payment handoff requires a matching invoice amount and either a matching description hash or a direct description confirmed in Step 9.
receipt_subscription_notice: This step discovers unverified candidates. It does not validate Zap Receipt IDs, signatures, authors, or tags.
no_receipt_candidates: No candidate Zap Receipt received yet
wait_receipt_prerequisite: Step 11 requires a matching invoice amount and Zap Request description hash, a signed Zap Request, recipient p tag, and at least one relay from its relays tag.
receipt_validation_notice: Validation starts only when requested. Candidate IDs are not trusted: each event ID and signature are independently verified.
field_expected_description: Exact Zap Request JSON sent to callback
validate_receipt_prerequisite: Step 12 requires at least one Step 11 candidate and the validated LNURL provider nostrPubkey.
qr_invoice_alt: QR code for opening this invoice in a Lightning wallet
qr_failure_instruction: {error}. Use Copy invoice or Open wallet instead.
